newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P says Australian corporate debt market grows.
newsitem.headline: S&P says Australian corporate debt market grows.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Thursday that the Australian corporate debt market was expanding and provided a number of benefits for medium-sized local companies.
Speaking at a briefing for institutions, S&P director of corp ratings Chris Legge said that corporate ratings had also helped the market's development.
"An expanding funding opportunity for industrial companies is the capital market issuance of longer term corporate bonds and medium term notes," Legge said.
"Anecdotal evidence supports the contention that credit ratings have facilitated the issuance and have improved funding costs."

Legge said that for a medium sized Australian company the benefits of issuing or borrowing from the domestic market meant there was no foreign exchange risk or hedge requirement and there were generally smaller borrowing requirements.
